recommendation: Keep the source fix. The ValueSet and binding are present; this removes the remaining stale reasonCode guidance without changing the approved Transport.reason name.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive-with-Modification OO issue asking to rename Transport.reason because it was confusing next to Transport.reasonCode and to fix missing TransportReason codes; final resolution kept the Transport.reason name because reasonCode was gone and required an example TransportReason ValueSet.
initial_application: Commit a8f7c81ebc added source/transport/valueset-transport-reason.xml and bound Transport.reason to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/transport-reason, but Transport.reason still described only a resource reference and still pointed free text to removed Transport.reasonCode.
additional_context: FHIR-39141 had previously removed reasonCode/reasonReference in favor of Transport.reason CodeableReference, and this worker published a separate FHIR-39141 cardinality fix. FHIR-50649 is already represented on the combined branch and confirms TransportReason was the remaining Transport ValueSet work after FHIR-50911 removed input/output. OO Confluence minutes for 2025-10-20 match the Jira resolution.
reconciliation: Updated the active StructureDefinition definition to say Transport.reason can be a code or resource reference, updated the comment to use Transport.reason.concept.text for uncoded text, and mirrored the wording in the Transport/Event mapping exception source.
source_changes: source/transport/structuredefinition-Transport.xml: changed Transport.reason definition from resource-reference-only to code-or-resource-reference and replaced Transport.reasonCode free-text guidance with Transport.reason.concept.text.
source/transport/transport-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: kept the Event mapping exception resource-side definition/comment in sync with the corrected Transport.reason wording.
